title: Handling Rate Limits from Third-Party APIs
content: When calling external APIs, implement exponential backoff with jitter and respect Retry-After headers to avoid cascading failures.

title: Why Our Checkout Page Latency Spiked
content: A post-incident review showing that an unindexed database query on the orders table caused a 3x latency increase during peak traffic.

title: Migrating from REST to GraphQL
content: Notes on incrementally introducing GraphQL alongside an existing REST API, including schema stitching and client migration order.

title: Debugging Memory Leaks in Node.js Services
content: Using heap snapshots and the --inspect flag to find detached closures and unbounded caches causing memory growth over time.

title: Setting Up CI for a Monorepo
content: Configuring pipeline caching and affected-project detection so CI only rebuilds and retests packages that actually changed.

title: Choosing Between SQL and NoSQL for a New Service
content: A comparison of relational and document databases based on query patterns, consistency needs, and expected write volume.

title: Authentication Patterns: Sessions vs JWTs
content: Trade-offs between server-side sessions and stateless JWTs, including revocation, storage, and cross-service authentication.

title: Improving Largest Contentful Paint on a Marketing Site
content: Steps taken to cut LCP from 4.2s to 1.6s, including image preloading, font subsetting, and removing render-blocking scripts.

title: Designing a Retry Queue for Failed Webhooks
content: How a delayed job queue with capped exponential backoff was used to reliably deliver webhooks despite intermittent consumer downtime.

title: Feature Flags Without Vendor Lock-In
content: Building a lightweight feature flag system backed by a config file and environment overrides, with a path to a hosted service later.

title: Load Testing an API Before a Product Launch
content: Using a load testing tool to simulate traffic spikes and identify the database connection pool as the first bottleneck.

title: Structuring Logs for Easier Incident Response
content: Moving to structured JSON logs with request IDs made it possible to trace a single request across multiple services during an outage.

title: Reducing Bundle Size in a Large React App
content: Code splitting by route and lazy-loading rarely used components reduced the initial JavaScript bundle by 40%.

title: Handling Partial Failures in Distributed Transactions
content: Using the saga pattern with compensating actions to keep data consistent when a multi-step transaction fails partway through.

title: Writing Idempotent API Endpoints
content: Using idempotency keys so that retried POST requests, such as payment submissions, don't create duplicate side effects.
